"AeroScout", "EX-5000", "200-2104-1000", "AD6232T1 41/11" :is silkscreened on the top (and bottom) of the main board. "TAG-3500", "20020475000", "AeroScout", and "AD5462T5 44/10" :is silkscreened on the [[G2 Microsystems]] Wi-Fi module.
The G2 Wi-Fi module is using a [http://embedded-computing.com/news/g2-family-low-power-wi-fiintegrated-circuits/ ''G2 Microsystems'' G2C547] :(G2C547-1) SoC for low power Wi-Fi capability. There appears to be an additional ''[[Freescale]]'' microcontroller on the board.
The additional RF module is using a ''[[Freescale]]'' M9S/M9S8GT6ACE (M9S8GT6A, :CE 4L11Y, CTAX1032) microcontroller and a ''[[Xilinx]]'' XC9572XL CPLD.
The microcontroller used in this device appears to be a [http://www.freescale.com/webapp/sps/site/prod_summary.jsp?code=MCF5225X MCF52258 (Coldfire)].
Per the FCC manual, the ''AeroScout'' EX5100 ''includes the following components''... :• Bidirectional Wi-Fi module with only the receiver enabled :• Wi-Fi transmitter ([http://www.aeroscout.com/t2 T2 Tag]) which is used by the Exciter for health management :• Exciter controller, 125 KHz LF Tx
The OUI specified on the FCC label is 00:0C:CC (''AeroScout''). This is assumed to be correct. :The sample FCC label also has "Stanley Healthcare Solutions" on it. :Likely P/N: 100-2105-1000 (Manuf. in Israel ?)
